title: Me’phaa, Acatepec | Ethnologue Free
text: Acatepec Me’phaa is a stable indigenous language of Mexico. It belongs to the Otomanguean language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
